name: Maricopa County, AZ
findings: Maricopa County has 11,394 nonprofit organizations. 4,788 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 3,760 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Maricopa County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Maricopa County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 306 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?
